data.title: 号角 · 檐下等雨
data.description: 风把雨丝吹进屋檐，她靠近你半步挡住风，发现距离有些近时，仍平静地笑了笑。
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: Huddled close beneath the dark canvas awning of a boutique shopfront during a torrential evening downpour, Horn looks toward the viewer with a rare, softening smile that eases her soldierly reserve. Rain cascades in shimmering curtains from the eaves, while warm shop window lights and wet street reflections cast radiant amber halos around their shared dry sanctuary.
data.animaCaption: Standing close beneath a dark boutique canvas awning during an evening downpour, she turns toward the viewer with a rare, softened smile. Warm shop window light reflects across the wet street beyond the streaming eaves.
